chapter.verse: A nung ciangin dahna lungsim tawh note kiangah ka hong pai kei ding ci-in ka lungsim ka hanciam hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in note ka hong dahsak leh, ka hong dahsakte longal, kei kua in hong lungdamsak ding hiam?
Ka lungdamna in note khempeuh lungdamna ahi hi ci-in ka lungmuang a, ka hong tun’ ciangin ka lung a hong damsak ding a kilawm mite pan dahna hong suah loh nadingin tu ma-in lai in ka hong khak hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lungman’na leh dahna tawh khitui tampi luangin lai ka hong gelh hi. Note heh nadingin ka hong gelh ahi kei hi: note ka hong itna lungsim na theih nadingun ka hong gelh hi.
Mi khatpeuh in dah nading ahih leh, kei hong dahsak lua ahi kei hi; note lak panin pawlkhat hangin hong dahsak hi. Tua bang ka hong cih ciangin nakpi-a lungkham luat loh nading ka ci hi.
Mi tampite’ thukhenna daan in tua bang mi ading a cing hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua bang mi in dah mahmahin kiphumcip a, a tummang loh nadingin note in ama mawhna maisakin amah na hehnep ding uh a kilawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in amah na it takpi uh na kilatsak nadingun kong thuum hi.
Tua tham loin, note in thu khempeuh na ngai uh hiam, na ngai kei uh hiam cih theih nopna tawh na zia uh enin, tu ma-in lai kong gelh hi.

Midangte mawhna na maisak uh leh, tuate’ mawhna keimah in zong ka maisak ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in mi khat mawhna ka maisak ngei leh, note hong ngaihsunin Khazih’ mai-ah ka maisak hi.
Tua ahih kei leh, Satan in ei hong zawh khak ding lunghihmawh huai hi. Ama hanciamna eite in i thei hi.
Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin Troas khua-ah ka tung a, Topa hangin kei ading kongkhak a kihon’ ciangin
ka sanggampa Titu ka muh loh ciangin ka lungnuam thei lo ahih manin, amaute mangpha khakin Makedonia gamah ka pai hi.
Khazih tawh zawhna pawikhamna-ah kote a tawntung hong paipih a, tua Topa theihtelna namtui, ko hangin mun khempeuh ah a kizeelsak Pasian’ hehpihna phatna a om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in gupna a ngahte tungah ahi zongin, kisiatna a ngahte tungah ahi zongin Khazih-a namtui i hi hi.
A kisia mite ading sih dongin sihna namtui i hi hi. Gupna a ngah mite adingin nuntakna a ngah dongun namtui i hi hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih nate tawh kua kilawm ahi hiam?
Met nadingin Pasian’ thu a zuak kawikawi mite tawh kote kibang loin, lungsim siangthoin Pasian’ sawltak mite bangin Pasian mai-ah lungsim tak tawh Khazih’ thu ka hilh uh hi.
